name: Emeis
summary: Emeis SA engages in the operation of geriatric healthcare facilities. It operates through the following geographical segments: France Benelux UK Ireland, Central Europe, Eastern Europe, Iberian Peninsula/Latin America, and Others. Its services include nursing homes, psychiatric care clinics, home care, and post-acute and rehabilitation clinics. The company was founded by Jean-Claude Marian in 1989 and is headquartered in Puteaux, France.
